name: Why is customer review management important for AEO for electricians?

mainEntity.name: Why is customer review management important for AEO for electricians?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer review management is crucial for AEO because search engines consider reputation and trust signals when determining which businesses to feature. Positive reviews, especially on platforms like Google Business Profile, enhance your credibility and indicate to search engines that your business provides valuable services. Responding to reviews, both positive and negative, further demonstrates engagement and professionalism, contributing to better local search visibility and AEO performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Customer reviews build trust and credibility, which search engines use to rank businesses for AEO, especially in local searches.
